metric_rationale: CRPS not constructible: each row carries a single scalar P(home win) pair (model_prob/market_prob) plus a 3-way settled outcome (1.0/0.5/0.0), never a distribution/ensemble -- no soccer conditional-distribution scoring engine exists (matches ingame_mlb.py's own other_sports_joinable note for soccer_intl). Paired Brier at fixed match-minute checkpoints is the metric this data supports.
honest_note: Calibration sharpness only, never a $/ROI claim. Checkpoints are match minute 60/75 (first row at-or-past that minute); games whose capture used the older minute-less state_summary format are excluded, not guessed. n is thin by construction (<=48 source games) -- UNDERPOWERED is the expected honest verdict here; this ships the harness + baseline for forward accrual.
